parameters.query:
SELECT
  event_id,
  task_id,
  customer_id,
  channel,
  channel_user_id,
  message_id,
  event_type,
  payload_kind,
  text,
  raw_payload,
  meta,
  created_at
FROM event_log
WHERE meta->'mvp'->>'name' = 'hermes_openclaw_line'
  AND meta->'mvp'->>'step_id' = '{{ $json.body.step_id || \"STEP_A\" }}'
  AND meta->'mvp'->>'runtime' = '{{ $json.body.runtime }}'
  AND meta->'mvp'->>'source_agent' = '{{ $json.body.source_agent }}'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT {{ $json.body.limit || 20 }};
